verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
I just want more, I just want more
More of You God, more of You God

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
I just want more, I just want more
More of You God, more of You

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
I pour out all I have I lay down all I am
I’m making room for You Lord I’m ready

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
To open up my heart To receive not in part
But the fullness of who You are Lord I’m ready

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
Come and reach into my heart,
come and heal every part Lord
I want more of You

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
Just one touch from Your robe
Steals the weakness from my bones
Oh I need more of You
